normalIntro.cn: summit 是最高点，是山与天空相接的地方。

normal.en: They reached the summit before dawn.
normal.cn: 他们在天亮前到达了山顶。

normal.en: The two leaders met at a summit.
normal.cn: 两位领导人在一次峰会上会面。

normal.en: Snow covered the summit all year.
normal.cn: 山顶终年积雪。

normal.en: She is at the summit of her career.
normal.cn: 她正处于事业的顶点。

normal.en: The summit talks lasted two days.
normal.cn: 峰会会谈持续了两天。

abstract.en: A summit is a place with nowhere higher to go.
abstract.cn: 顶峰是一个再没有更高处可去的地方。

abstract.en: Every summit is also a beginning of the descent.
abstract.cn: 每个顶峰也都是下山的开始。

abstract.en: Leaders climb to summits to see farther.
abstract.cn: 领导人登上峰会，是为了看得更远。

dict_mnemonic.text: summit 与 sum（总数）同出拉丁语 summus（最高的），本指山顶，又引申为最高级别的峰会与事业的顶点。

root: 来自拉丁语 summus（最高的），经古法语 sommet（山顶）进入英语，由山顶引申为峰会与顶点。

sensesIntro.en: Summit means the top of a mountain, a meeting of leaders, or the highest point of anything.
sensesIntro.cn: summit 表示山顶、领导人峰会，或任何事物的最高点。

core.en: The highest point, physical or not.
core.cn: 最高点，无论具体还是抽象。

branches.en: They reached the summit before dawn.
branches.cn: 他们在天亮前到达了山顶。

branches.en: Snow covered the summit all year.
branches.cn: 山顶终年积雪。

branches.en: The two leaders met at a summit.
branches.cn: 两位领导人在一次峰会上会面。

branches.en: She is at the summit of her career.
branches.cn: 她正处于事业的顶点。

branches.en: The highest place and the highest moment share a name.
branches.cn: 最高的地方与最高的时刻共用一个名字。

intro.en: Summit forms summiteer and summitry in political use.
intro.cn: summit 在政治语境中可构成 summiteer 和 summitry。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin summus, highest.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根是拉丁语 summus，意为最高的。

The summiteers posed for a photo.
The summit talks lasted two days.

latinEntries.example: Summus is the source of summit.
latinEntries.exampleCN: summus 是 summit 的来源。

latinEntries.example: Summa shares the same root.
latinEntries.exampleCN: summa 与它同根。

definition_en: the star that gives light and heat to the earth
core_image: 一轮太阳从云层后探出头来，把光洒在田野上
scene: 太阳从云后出来了。The sun came out from behind the clouds.
sceneCN: 这里 sun 是「太阳」（第 1 个义项）；句意：太阳从云后出来了。

senses.title: The star of our sky
senses.definition: the star that gives the earth light and heat
senses.definitionCN: 为地球提供光和热的恒星
senses.example: The sun came out from behind the clouds.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳从云后出来了。
senses.why: This is the basic astronomical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的天文义项。

senses.title: Sunlight
senses.definition: the light and warmth of the sun
senses.definitionCN: 太阳的光和热
senses.example: Sit in the sun and warm up.
senses.exampleCN: 坐到阳光下暖和一下。
senses.why: Here the word means the light, not the star.
senses.whyCN: 这里指光，而不是那颗恒星。

senses.title: To sit in the sun
senses.definition: to expose yourself to sunlight
senses.definitionCN: 让自己暴露在阳光下
senses.example: They sunned themselves on the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在海滩上晒太阳。
senses.why: This is the verb use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是该词的动词用法。

intro.en: Sun is one of the oldest Germanic words, older than writing in English.
intro.cn: sun 是最古老的日耳曼语词之一，比英语文字还要古老。

items.en: Sunno named the sun.
Sunne meant the sun.
Sunne became sunne and sun.
items.cn: sunne 逐渐写作 sunne 和 sun。

items.en: Sun named the star and its light.
It also became a verb meaning to bask.
items.cn: 它又成为动词，表示晒太阳。

note.en: Sun is compared with look-alike words and with words for sunlight.
note.cn: 把 sun 与形近词以及表示阳光的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sun is the star we see by day and the light it sends us.
normalIntro.cn: sun 是我们白天看见的那颗恒星，也是它送来的光。

normal.en: The sun came out from behind the clouds.
normal.cn: 太阳从云后出来了。

normal.en: The sun rises early in summer.
normal.cn: 夏天太阳升起得早。

normal.en: The morning sun filled the room.
normal.cn: 朝阳照满了房间。

abstract.en: The sun asks for nothing and gives everything.
abstract.cn: 太阳一无所求，却给出一切。

abstract.en: Every shadow is proof that the sun is there.
abstract.cn: 每一道影子都证明太阳就在那里。

abstract.en: We turn toward light without being taught.
abstract.cn: 我们不用被教，就会转向光。
